title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Image effects in Microsoft 365 Copilot
description: We’re adding a new set of image effects to Microsoft 365 Copilot that make it easy to enhance your visuals. Whether you're using AI-generated images or uploading your own, you can apply these effects in the Create experience or directly in Copilot Chat to make your content stand out.
